description: This Java class 'HtmlTreeRenderer' is an implementation of a tree-rendering component for HTML UI widgets, part of the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to render tree nodes, labels, links, and images in HTML format, utilizing context data and model definitions, and handles complex interactions such as node expansion, URL generation, and integration with other rendering components.

classes.name: HtmlTreeRenderer
classes.description: A deprecated HTML widget renderer for rendering tree structures in the OFBiz framework, providing methods for rendering nodes, labels, links, and images within an HTML context, and integrating with the macro screen renderer.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Render the beginning of a tree node, including opening tags and expansion logic.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Render the closing tags for a tree node, and handle boundary comments if root.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Render the last element in the node list, potentially opening a new UL if processChildren is true.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Render a label for a tree node as a span element.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Render a hyperlink for a tree node's link, with URL handling based on mode.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Render an image element with appropriate attributes and URL resolution.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Retrieve or initialize the screen string renderer, typically for macro rendering.
